title: DigiPlus Foundation provides relief to over 24,000 Filipinos affected by Habagat across Luzon

blocks.text: DigiPlus Foundation reinforced its commitment to supporting communities in times of crisis, extending humanitarian assistance to more than 24,000 Filipinos affected by the southwest monsoon, or Habagat, through five relief operations conducted across Metro Manila, Pangasinan, Pampanga, and Bulacan from August 27 to September 22. Through its BayanihanPlus program, the Foundation mobilized relief assistance for communities affected by prolonged rains and flooding in four major flooded zone areas in Luzon, distributing essential supplies such as rice, drinking water, and other basic necessities to help families address their immediate needs.
